mphil/nuclear-energy/2019/ne2.reason: The official 2019 4I10 crib covers all four questions and all a–d parts of this NE2 paper. No new solution draft is needed.

matched_questions.1: Annular fuel with ten-percent void versus ten-percent BeO and fifty-percent conductivity gain; reactivity and temperature consequences.
matched_questions.2: Doubled gas pressure at fixed pumping power, temperature rise and core geometry; film heat transfer and pressure-drop discussion.
matched_questions.3: AP1000 passive containment tank, seventy-two-hour balance at 3000 MWth, accident sources and sinks, eighteen-month two-batch versus continuous three-year refuelling.
matched_questions.4: Temperature and xenon feedback, MTC changes, table temperatures 80/300/900 with reactivities 0/-2000/-4000/-6000.
